text:
Summary: Token exfiltration in demo-thirdparty/s3-sync.

Severity: High.

Affected versions: v1.
Patched versions: v2.

A dependency of the v1 Action sends the runner's environment, including temporary cloud credentials, to a third-party host. Any workflow that ran an affected version should treat the credentials it held as exposed.

Upgrade to v2, pin the reviewed commit, and rotate credentials the workflow could read.
